title: Majaz: Ae Gham-e-Dil Kya Karun
description: The movie based on the real life story of famous poet, Asrar ul Haq Majaz . Majaz (Priyanshu Chaterjee) is a romantic poet. Despite gaining an early fame he soon became an alcoholic. His alcohol problem worsens when he falls in love with one of his admirer who is also married.

title: Ripa Hits the Skids
description: A week-long glimpse into the wretched existence of Ripa, a long-haired, hard-drinking lug. He is also a wannabe filmmaker whose last two projects were condemned for their sex and violence. A Parasite Deluxe who barely recalls his previous night, Ripa cruises the bars and meets bank-teller Tiina.

title: Pikajuna pohjoiseen
description: The destinies of different kind of people encounter in a passenger train that is traveling from Helsinki to the Norht.

title: Prisma: Illustrerad konst- och kulturrevy
description: "Prisma: illustrated art and cultural revue" - about current events, trends and notable people in the world of artistic culture.
A weekly news and current event program with in-depth reports and conversations.

title: Tilde
description: Tilde is a live interview program from Junibacken's terrace on Djurgården in the middle of Stockholm's inner city.

title: Lain mukaan
description: About a woman who out of greed and vanity sells herself to a rich squire.

title: 8-Ball
description: Single mother name Pike who, having just been released from prison, is trying to start her news life anew. When her former boyfriend Lalli come back from abroad, it open a window into her past that Pike want to put behind her.

title: Matters of the Heart
description: Follows a middle-class family who, on the surface, have a happy and perfect life. But behind the facade, the family is on the verge of disintegration due to the father's escalating alcohol consumption.

title: Holy Mess
description: A gay couple invites their somewhat-homophobic families to meet for the first time during Christmastime, and they have a special gift for them.

title: Vain kaksi tuntia
description: Jännitysdraama pikkukaupungin sairaalasta jossa syyllisyyden ja mustasukkaisuuden riivaama ylilääkäri turvautuu äärimmäiseen ratkaisuun.

title: Verden er fuld af børn
description: A young couple wants to have children but cannot have them. When it turns out that it is due to the man's sterility, a crisis arises in the relationship.

title: Mañana
description: Marcos has never had a girlfriend. Mattias has been with the same girl for way too long. That's the upbeat of Swedish-Chilean director Manuel Conchas first feature, where two child hood best friends are about to meet the reality of adulthood. Or as Marcos father likes to put it: Grow some hair on their balls!

title: Who the Hell Are Our Untold Story!?
description: A documentary following the first 2 years of Swedish rock band OUS as they journey on their quest to spread their music.

title: Det var en gång en sjöman
description: Shipmate Öman comes to the north-African city of Jazzablanca, a nest of sin with prostitution and organized crime.

title: Ud af mørket
description: A couple of reckless decisions lead to fatal consequences for four young friends. Johnny and Milla are a young couple whose safe every day life takes an unexpected turn when Johnny's old childhood friend, Nino, suddenly makes contact. Nino's younger brother Miki, has a huge debt to settle and needs to come up with 850.000 dkk (about $160,000) by midnight- the same night. Due to Nino's impulsive cash-fueled decisions, the three friends hunt for money leads them deep inside the dirty underworld of Copenhagen and within a short time; they find themselves hunted throughout the streets. In one night - loyalty, love and friendship are put to the test.

title: Hallin Janne
description: 1800-luvun lopulla Längelmäellä tehtiin raaka veriteko jossa kaksi miestä tappoi postelijoonin ja ryösti postilaukun rahat. Perustuu tositapahtumiin.

title: Brottmålsdomaren
description: Criminal judge Evald Sterner and engineer Kai Falk are rivals of the beautiful Jesta Fridman, daughter of the rich banker.

title: Kapitler af Danmarks historie
description: Over five seasons, historians Palle Lauring and Erik Kjersgaard delve into significant chapters from the history of Denmark.

title: Sockerexperimentet
description: The film is inspired by a controversial experiment that took place in Sweden in 1948.

title: Law of the Land
description: In this arctic western on the Finnish-Norwegian border, an illegitimate son of a retiring police officer is released from prison and is terrorizing the area. It soon spirals out of control and turns violent, forcing him to face his past.

title: Lyden af Louis venner
description: We find Louis in a large workshop filled with valuable junk. In his trashed van we travel to Aarhus to visit his first friend out of many, in this series. This first episode shows flat tires on the highway, bloodthirsty dogs on the savannah of Jutland, a draisine at full speed towards "Braband Haveforening" and jolly talk about anarchism over a literally smoking grill. This is RECORDING LOUIS.

title: Et billede af mit liv
description: A portrait of Rigmor Mydtskov, portrait and theatre photographer. As well as being the Royal Danish photographer, she is one of the highest estimated photographers in Denmark.

title: Vi två
description: Widower Robert Rossiter lives in New York with his two teenage children. When he visits a fashion house one day, he falls in love with the store clerk Joyce Roamer.

title: Mauro & Pluras kök
description: Mauro & Pluras kök

title: Lyckligare kan ingen vara
description: The story revolve around five couples of different generations. Their lives are woven together by coincidences but sometimes through very deliberate choices where the common driving force is the search for love.

title: 92 minutter af i går
description: A French businessman meets a Danish girl in Copenhagen. The two feel attracted to each other, but the girl does not understand French and the man does not understand Danish.

title: Creepy AF
description: An online paranormal series from horror director Ace Jordan. Hosted by Erik Vanlier, special guest investigator on Ghost Adventures, Good Mythical Morning and more!

title: Döden, Döden, Döden
description: Anna Lindman tries to get to know man's greatest fear and seeks answers to questions about death that we ask.

title: Flickorna på Solvik
description: In the Skåne manor house Cronoholm, the rich Baron Rutger Cronsköld live with his two children Börje and Martha.

title: En mand af betydning
description: In one of Copenhagen's suburban municipalities, Baldur Justesen is the owner of a dairy company.

title: Ministerpresidenten
description: Newspaper man Jean Bazard and Lawyer Alphonse Carrel are rivals of the beautiful Rose Legrange.

title: Sommarkollo
description: Sommarkollo is a web and TV drama series for 8-12 year olds where we follow five 12-year old kids during a weeklong summer camp. A Scandinavian summer filled with drama, love, disappointments, friends and adventure.

title: Jill and Joy's Winter
description: Jill and Joy (both 9) live in their own house like any other little girls, except that they might be a little happier than most little girls, as they get to live in their own house specifically designed for the two. One December evening a small car, barely the size of a shoebox, pulls up in front their house, and a teensy-weensy family gets out: the McTiny family. The family has become homeless after a road-roller smashed their home. Planning to live with the girls temporarily, the family moves in with Jill and Joy but soon finds out that not all big people have good intentions towards them.

title: Måndagsbörsen
description: Live music from the Hamburger Börs in Stockholm.

title: Swoon
description: A sensational story of forbidden love, a rivalry between two families and a war between two amusement parks. A magic story based on the real history of Gröna Lund, an actual amusement park in Stockholm - the capital of Sweden.

title: Kärleken segrar
description: Farm girl Olga Ström is seduced by the Hans Brandt, who soon abandons her, even though she carries their child.

title: Kim Novak Never Swam in Genesaret's Lake
description: The year is 1962. Erik, his newly acquainted friend Edmund and his grown-up brother Henry are going to spend their summer holiday in a fairly decayed house just near the lake Genesaret. One day, Ewa Kaludis, who looks like Kim Novak, turns up at the place while the summer continues to be the best ever - until it comes to a halt as she begins a fatal relationship with Henry and "the terrible thing" happens ... and nobody knows who dunnit.

title: Broken Hill Blues

title: Ah Beng the Movie: 3 Wishes
description: It's the eve of The Lunar New Year in a village. Every household is busy preparing to receive the auspicious God Of Fortune (GOF). Comes midnight, people of various races impersonate the GOF. They walk up to each household to offer mandarin oranges and lucky numbers in return for an "Ang Pau". Ah Beng's father being poor, dishes out only coins to these GOF. The worst dressed scruffy GOF who receives a tiny token from Ah Beng's father, is in fact, the true and almighty GOF. Without realizing, Ah Beng's father comments that he should be better dressed and wishes him good luck and good health, very sincerely. The true GOF is surprised but touched by Ah Beng's father's sincerity and grants him 3 wishes. Not-so-bright security guard Ah Beng works at an open car-park, is being bullied by a group of rich brats with luxury cars, over their parking fee. A mysterious guy comes in and helps Ah Beng. Grateful for his help, Ah Beng invites him into his life and things starts to change around him. One day at work, Bobby is injured while filming and with the help of Ah Beng, Rain and the mysterious guy, Bobby is brought to the hospital where they see both Ah Lian and Salted Fish Lian. Salted Fish Lian was collecting her medicine from the pharmacy. Ah Beng and the gang secretly investigates Salted Fish Lian's condition and is shocked to find out that Salted Fish Lian is very sick. Back home, Ah Beng and the gang, are thinking of ways to save Salted Fish Lian. Bobby then spots a Talent Search contest in a newspaper with a massive grand prize of cash. Rain, Bobby and Ah Beng quickly form a singing trio to join the contest. Do they win? Who is the Mysterious Guy? Why is he there?

title: Ah ma yau nan
description: Yiu Chun-Man, a gay fashion designer in Hong Kong, gets a visit from twin brother Yiu Chun-Kit. Kit is visiting from Thailand and promptly takes Man's expensive car out for a spin and gets into a horrendous accident in which a woamn dies, and Kit was driving with Man's license. Since the revelation of Kit's true identity would be a real legal tangle, Kit is forced to assume Man's identity and vice-versa. description: As fun-seeking tourists converge on the beautiful Caribbean island of Antigua, several interconnected stories merge into one.

title: That's AI
description: In a near-future conversation, two people question whether the images, emotions, and stories they see are created by humans or by artificial intelligence. As the line between reality and machine-generated creativity begins to blur, they are forced to confront what authenticity truly means in the age of AI.

title: Je vous ai compris
description: On the night of April 21st 1961, in an attempt to halt the policy implemented by General de Gaulle which led to Algeria's independence, the 1st Foreign Regiment of Parachutists took power in Algiers. At the same time, Malika, Jacquot and Thomas prepare to face their future. All three of them are between 20 and 30, all love Algeria but each in different ways. An innovative historical animation.

title: Above the Line
description: Hosts AJ Mandeville and Ryan Wydeveld take you on a fun-filled trip through Indywood, the bustling world of independent film thriving in Northern California. Above the Line features segments like "Pints and the Pipeline", where our hosts get to know up-and-coming projects and talent over an ice cold pint of locally brewed beer; "Martini Shots", where we enjoy a hand-crafted martini with Producers and Directors as their projects wrap; "Chewing the Scene", in which we sit down one-on-one with actors to discuss especially powerful or talented scenes and their process of bringing them to life; and "All Set Up", a DIY series about the secrets of movie magic.

title: Nona
description: Stephen King's popular short horror story comes to life on the screen. A young man in prison recounts the events that have led him there. He tells the story of how he met and fell in love with a beautiful girl named Nona. The loving couple sets out on a journey where they encounter many different characters. While encountering these new characters, the man is changed by Nona's mysterious seduction and starts to slowly slip into madness. The adventure is filled with unexpected twists and turns until the very last second. The journey starts to comes to a close near Stephen King's fictional town of Castle Rock when Nona lures the narrator to a graveyard. There she asks her repeated question 'Do you love?'. It is up to the audience to decipher whether or not Nona was a figment of insanity or was actually a real person. The movie ends with a true question being asked, "How far would you go for love?"

title: Us x Her
description: A young couple's shaky marriage becomes more chaotic when an other woman comes into the picture. But what happens when the two women fall in love with each other?

title: The Devil's Bargain
description: It's 1974. Earth is about to be obliterated by a massive asteroid. Adi (Jonnie Hurn) and his young hippy wife Ange (Chloe Farnworth), haunted by memories of the death of their child a few years earlier, journey to the idyllic rural setting where he was conceived, determined to make peace with the world and each other before the planet is destroyed forever. Adi's overly pragmatic view of life and 'what comes afterwards' (or doesn't) begins to grate with the free-spirited Ange. She seduces the reluctant Adi into reliving happier times, and for a moment it seems as if this troubled couple may actually find peace at the end. But the arrival of Luca (Dan Burman), a charismatic and mysterious young photographer, turns what's left of the world upside-down. Despite Adi's aggressive reaction to Luca taking photos of him and his wife naked, Luca manages to persuade the couple to allow him to ride out the end of days with them. It soon becomes clear that Ange wants to enjoy the company of both men and that Luca's arrival on the scene may not have been entirely accidental. But there is more at work here than free love and cuckolding. Luca is clearly a man of power, and as the asteroid careens closer to the earth the tensions rise between the three, and what could have been a peaceful swansong for Adi becomes a litany of revelations, personal and biblical, a psychological nightmare, and a hellish final judgment.

title: Headed South for Christmas
description: A comedic family film that follows MACKENZIE, an angst-ridden 14 year old girl (Abby Corrigan) whose mother died during childbirth. Mackenzie and her father Ash (David Garrett), who is a strong caring man and loves his family, partake on a journey to the quirky South Georgia town of McClellan to visit his sister Sally (Mandi Christine Kerr) for the first time since Mackenzie was little. On the way down, Mackenzie is sullen and irritable because she has to spend her Christmas away from the city (Atlanta) with relatives she doesn't like in a town she is not fond of. Upon arrival to Sally's house, Sally's 8 year old son Tyler (Luke Westerfield) excitedly talks to Mackenzie about Christmas and the Preceding week's Duck Days festivities which Ash reveals is a big tradition in this tiny town. While celebrating the festivities and shopping for Christmas gifts, Mackenzie and Tyler go to see Santa. He is not at his post, but the two teens run into him in the local café. When Tyler is too star-struck to talk to his holiday hero, he asks Mack to take his list to St. Nick. During their conversation, Mack quickly lets Santa know she does not believe in Christmas, Santa, or Duck Days for that matter and her only wish for Christmas would be to meet her mother for the first time. Will her wish come true?

title: Sue Inside

title: The Outlier

title: Time
description: Nate's best friend who is also Claire's boyfriend, Evan, is sent to jail for a year under some rather unclear circumstances. This sudden absence causes them to reevaluate not only their own lives, but their individual connections to Evan. Nate and Claire turn to their long time friends Veronica and Dan in the hopes of gaining perspective. Upon Evan's return his relationships with both Nate and Claire are clearly fractured. Struggling to rebuild his life and his relationships weighs heavily on Evan and forces him to fight for what he's lost, at all costs.

title: Last Save Point
description: In a scorched, post-apocalyptic world, survival is fragile and trust is dangerous. When a hardened loner discovers a naive man with the mind of a child, the two form an uneasy alliance, their journey colliding with a sinister school where the once students (now adults) are still ruled by the authority figures of the past. Fear, secrets, and the threats prevent them from exploring whats beyond their gated community.

title: Thanks to Her
description: THANKS TO HER tells the story of Millie Blake, a high school soccer star who feels like she doesn't quite fit in with her popular friends. After trying to break up a fight with another student Andy Wellick, who is outspoken about her identity as a lesbian on the asexual spectrum, both girls land themselves with community service at a local nursing home. Initially, they butt heads, but the tension quickly blossoms into friendship as they learn more about each other. As time goes on and Millie's friendship with Andy grows into something more, she finds herself trying to find the courage to finally show her true self to her friends and family. This coming of age, all-inclusive LGBTQ+ film focuses on the self, sexuality, and how that plays out in one's community.

title: Al-Taghriba Al-Filistinia
description: A Syrian series about the Palestinian exodus in 1948 after the Israeli occupation to Palestine.

title: Al-Fajer Al-Hazeen
description: When parents felt fear for their sons and wives from the possibility of being subjected to bomb and missile issues as a result of the war in 1991, they chose to send these children and women to shelters in their areas of residence .. In the Amiriyah shelter west of Baghdad, about 450 people, women, children, boys and old people always felt Reassured through their presence in this shelter .. where children play under the light of the light bulbs that were interrupted from the role of their residence .. The girls intercourse in talks about life, war and love .. and when everyone slept while they were satisfied .. some of them were worried about their families who are outside the shelter From bombing and bomb issues. At the dawn of that sad day, those outside the shelter outnumbered two rockets that penetrated the shelter, and most of the women and children in it died. Their relatives were torn apart by grief while sticking to the fence of the shelter waiting .. and waiting without success because the two missiles were (smart) missiles intended to kill These are in advance and everyone died.

title: Fursan Al Zalam: Zhiaab Al Layl
description: In a city besieged by forces of evil, love blossoms between Salma and Zaid, but things take a turn when Abu Al Dahma forcibly marries her, and Zaid sets out to take revenge on him, especially after Abu Al Dahma wreaks havoc in the city along with the chief guard Abu Al Dawrak and the sorcerer Abu Al Hakam.

title: Al Hadaf: Saeed Al Owairan
description: It follows the life of Saudi national team player Saeed Al Owairan, through the difficulties he went through from his humble beginning until he became one of the most important footballers in the Saudi team.

title: Al Sigil Al Aswad
description: A love story arises between a young man and a girl, however, the boy is exposed to many psychological problems due to the magic carried out by a charlatan to destroy his life.

title: Al-Azwag Al-Shayateen
description: Mamdooh, Kamel and Fathi are three friends who work in one company. Kamel and Fathi are married while Mamdooh is a single person who rents a float for his pleasures. Kamel and Fathi visit him escaping from their wives. Naimah steels the jewelry of her employer, who chases her. She runs away by riding in Mamdooh's car. Mamdooh takes Naimah to the float, hoping to spend a good time with her. His friends Kamel and Fathi come to share in the fun, but the police came and captured everyone after Naimah hidden the stolen jewelry in the float's sofa. Naimah was detained and the three young men were released. Mamdooh visits his friend Kamel at home and saw Magdah, his sister-in-law, and marries her. Naimah comes out of prison and chases the couples until she reaches the float and recovers the stolen goods. But the wives arrive with the police who arrest Naimah and get the stolen jewelry. The husbands were released but were chased by the wives.

title: Al Thalab W Al Enab
description: Mohsen is graduated from law school and looking for a job, his sister's husband works as a driver for the minister and Mohsen is being moved from one job to another easily after he fails the previous one because of this connection he has, he doesn't know the suffering of young people in his age looking for a job, his girlfriend is always telling him to depend on himself and not others.

title: Al Abaa' al Sighar
description: Social drama movie about a family whose mother is dead and the father remains the only breadwinner and the responsible of upbringing his four children.

title: Al Saf Al Akheer
description: A young man who has little experience with life and looks at everything around him from one angle, embarks on a journey from one day that turns all his concepts upside down.

title: Rechazando al Fénix, Domando al Dragón
description: Samara, marcada por una mancha de nacimiento y una rivalidad constante con su hermana Sienna, sufre traición y manipulación. En un mundo donde los vínculos entre humanos y bestias son vitales, Samara forma un vínculo con el dragón Alaric, lo que cura su maldición. Descubre su propia fuerza, expone el engaño de Sienna y encuentra la aceptación a través de la transformación y su nuevo vínculo con Alaric.

title: Al Fin y Al Cabo
description: Two FBI agents arrive to the Dominican Republic to come after a drug lord called "El Duque". Local policeman Cabo Azulado and petty thief Joe help them with their investigation.

title: Al Hujra
description: The plot deals with a different aspect of psychological and mental illness, which is dissociative identity disorder, a condition that is a double-edged sword that may help in revenge. revenge.

title: Al-azraa wa al shaar al abyad
description: After a woman loses hope of bearing a child of her own, she adopts an orphan against her husband's will, but when the child becomes a young woman, she falls in love with her adoptive father.

title: United States of Al S1-S2
description: The friendship between Riley, a Marine combat veteran struggling to readjust to civilian life in Ohio, and Awalmir, the Afghan interpreter who served with his unit and has just arrived to start a new life in America.

title: Al-suq al-Soda'
description: A corrupt grocer in a traditional Cairene neighborhood enters into an alliance with comprador merchants. Their goal is to hoard scarce commodities during the World WAR II, and then to sell them at vastly inflated prices. Eventually the grocer's neighbors rebel at his tactics. They call in the national athorities and the black marketeers are brought to justice.

title: Al Dahik Al Baki
description: The events depict the story of the famous actor Naguib El Rehany since childhood and highlight the human and social aspects of his life, as well as the political events he witnessed, especially the 1919 Revolution, the First and Second World Wars, the Constitution of 1923, and the British occupation of Egypt.

title: Al koubla al akhira
description: Sami is a film director, who adopts the new actress Naira, falls in love with her, becomes a famous star, marries her, and grows her name in the art world, but during the production of one of their films, he is surprised that a severe love story has been born between his wife and the new actor Raouf, the director feels powerless in front of these feelings The fledgling, sense of danger is approaching his career and family.

title: Al Sajeen Al Nsaab
description: A highly intelligent fraudster, who possesses many skills in scamming his victims of celebrities and businessmen, succeeds in forming a team to help him in the fraud operations, so the police forces seek the help of university professor Dr. Shamlan to help them catch him.

title: Al Barrany
description: The series tells the story of a family through three brothers and the relationship between them and their interests.

title: Al Haram
description: Adam and Laura's love story culminates with a marriage that's built on secrets from a past that follows them. Laura and her former secret relationship with an older man, and Adam whom Alice left to marry a wealthy man.

title: Al watad
description: Social drama Based on a true story about life in the Egyptian countryside .

title: Al Naguib
description: Take a trip inside the mind of Naguib Mahfouz the Egyptian Famous writer. these biographical documentary series trace Mahfouz's Journey to becoming the first and only Egyptian to win the Nobel Prize in Literature.

title: Al jawareh
description: A tribal Sheikh, Ibn Al Wahhaj, decides to test his three sons, Al Bashq, Osama, and Akab, by sending each of them to a different location to put their abilities to live on their own to the test.

title: Al Haqaeb
description: The story of an ordinary Syrian family, torn between the idea of staying at home or migrating to a safer country. They eventually decide to leave, but they keep facing different obstacles in each of the separated-connected episodes.

title: Al-Bidaya
description: After a crash, a group of passengers are stranded in the desert. They attempt to cope with their new conditions as the most privileged of them all, an overpaid lawyer, declares himself a dictator of the nearby oasis and names it after him.

title: Al Armala W Al Shaytan
description: A wealthy widow accused of killing her husband for his money and Gad a Lebanese man who returned from Canada. After they get married, he runs her business but the widow goes through a psychological conflict with a two-faced husband.

title: Al Omm
description: A mother of six dies alone. Due to the political upheaval in Syria, her children are unable to make it for the funeral and she is buried with none of her children present.

title: Al Roub
description: Criminals steal a cargo of atomic substance, the police with the help of a journalist tries to capture them but things get more complicated when two individuals steal the cargo from the criminals.

title: Al-Fetewa
description: In the world of local neighborhoods, a sect of strong people come together to manage the affairs of these neighborhoods. Known as Al-Fetewa, they are ruffians who shoulder the responsibility of the people in their neighborhoods.

title: Al Hayba: Ras Al Jabal
description: Yasmina returns with her young son from Montreal to Morocco to bury her husband, only to find herself trapped in Ras Al Jabal, a dangerous world of trafficking, clan conflicts, and tribal power, ruled by her brother-in-law Layl, the village's feared and ruthless kingpin, where survival comes at a high cost.

title: Al Zawga Al Oula
description: Dr. Rima's family life is turned upside down after learning about her husband Akram's affair with Karen, and events escalate over time.

title: Al Morshed
description: Mabrouk comes from his village, and on the train he meets Nawara. He helps her to escape from her uncle who wants to kill her to defend his honor. He also meets Hashim, who tries to quit being an informer for officer Sharif.

title: Al Kahf
description: A Bedouin series that tackles tribal conflicts, as the twins Ghazwan and Marar try to uncover the mystery of a cave, but love prevents that, as Marar falls for Shiha, leading him to decide to help her tribe and stand up to Ghazwan.

title: Al Makida
description: Khaled, a man in his sixties, was murdered in mysterious circumstances and the killer remains unidentified. Several unsolved crimes have been committed in the same house until the police devise a plan to capture the real killer.

title: Al Misbah
description: A Bahraini stand-alone episodic series on YouTube centered loosely around social stereotypical scenarios in Bahrain featuring an all renown comedians and A-Lister's. The series is created by Ahmed Sharif, social media celebrity and critically-acclaimed artist.

title: Al-Faslah
description: Marzooq has an accident while on a private trip out of Kuwait. His family falsely told that he had died. Almost one and a half year later, he returns to Kuwait to discover that his brother and wife took possession of his large and suitably-located house, turning it to hotel and rest house. Marzooq starts trying to repossess his house.

title: Al-avokato
description: A cunning lawyer who tries to manipulate law and do everything in order to win is sent to jail for one month, he meets two important characters, drug lord and an ex-politician, he tries to play with them both to gain money but his actions lead him to unexpected end.

title: 3:15 am
description: The First French Found Footage Horror Anthology.

title: I Am Cait
description: Follows the transformation of Bruce Jenner from a man to Caitlyn Jenner, a woman, by showing the struggles and publicity of changing gender.

title: Banat Al Am
description: Khawla is forced to live in her uncle's house, Nouri, after her father's death as well as her mother's marriage and travel abroad. Many problems arise between her and her cousins, especially her cousin, Afaf, who studies with her in the same college.

title: Am Yisrael Hai
description: A minor politician, suffering with a temporary sexual disorder that is soon to be written about in the local press, is sent anonymously to Eilat for rest and pleasantries. His wife, believing he was on a trip abroad also goes to Eilat on the advice of her friend.

title: I Am Sorry
description: Rahi's mistake disturbed her. One day she started to search the victim and she got to know the other person get a lot suffered, she try to solve all the errors of his life.

title: I Am CCA
description: Chris Martin has been a detention officer in San Diego since 2008. The flexibility and the support system CCA provides affords him the opportunity to pursue his dream to compete as a professional boxer. "I'm very grateful for the type of job I have and the time they allow me and just the support that I get from work," Martin says. Well-liked at his San Diego facility, Martin's so unassuming, one might find it hard to believe he's a revered boxer on a national level. Boxers must adhere to a strict diet and a vigorous work-out routine the week before a fight, and Martin's warden works with him to ensure he can take vacation time off to prepare for his fights. "He's always very supportive," Martin notes. "In my second to last fight, my warden actually went to one of my fights, so I thought that was nice of him to take the time and go out and watch the fight." Martin's co-workers are his biggest cheerleaders. They often attend his fights and loyally follow his career. The immense support his work family supplies gives him confidence to continue chasing his dream, all the while providing for his family.

title: I Am Worker
description: Sadegh, a simple worker, lives in a rented house with his mother and wife. Although he is a hard-working man, he is unemployed most days because of his simplicity, which has made it difficult for him to earn a living.

title: I Am Makimoto
description: So Makimoto works in the omiokuri department at city hall. The department's main responsibility is to hold funerals for deceased individuals without family members and bury them at a cemetery. So doesn't like to socialize with or listen to other people. By doing his job, he meets various people and slowly begins to change his life.

title: I Am Fan
description: Explores the artist-to-fan relationship and how it has evolved through the ages. The film stars pop-punk band Simple Plan, crooner Paul Anka and singer Roch Voisine, not to mention their most loyal fans.

title: I Am Mother
description: The unattractive mother endures hardship to raise her two sons. Tragically, the younger son drowns in an accident, and the elder, whom she painstakingly raised, denies her to marry into a prestigious family. Fortunately, the younger son, now a CEO, appears and protects his mother, making those who bullied her pay the price. And the unattractive mother, through her kindness and hard work, successfully earns everyone's love and respect.

title: WJHC AM
description: A smart ass DJ wants to start a career in radio, but the only place that will hire him is an old Southern Gospel Radio station. His first night shift happens during Y2K AND the rapture. Literally, all hell breaks loose.

title: Am Fenster
description: A couple reviews the best moments of their life together to face the break-up of their relationship.

title: Am I Here?
description: AM I HERE? explores life on the streets of Ireland's capital, making visible the lives and stories that thousands of feet walk past everyday.

title: I Am Orig
description: Comedian Nathan Cassidy's award-nominated documentary of a year giving his own money away. It's funny, uplifting, and tells the story of a man who saved his whole life for a day that never came.

title: I Am William
description: William lives with his uncle Nils. His father is dead and his mother is mentally unstable. Nils retired early and spends his day buying and selling stuff at a favourable price. Nils owes some gangsters money and they want their debt paid back.

title: I am Unique
description: A life of insurmountable hardship for young Unique, including physical and mental challenges, does not stop her from fulfilling a promise to her sister, who had died in her arms.

title: I Am Boxer
description: Don Lee's extreme boxing survival show. Who will survive to be the champion standing in the ring?

description: An actress from the big city encourages the proprietor of a resort inn in the Austrian Tyrol to try his luck on the stage in Berlin.

title: Here Am I
description: The film tells the story of a village ruined in war and the fright of a boy and a mute scribe who carry with them a sacred Hebrew text.

title: I Am That
description: A nun's eight-day adventure to resolve questions of doubt, unites her with a gentle teenager and a handsome drifter who will affect her heart and future as she makes a pilgrimage to the site of her sister's death.

description: In post apocalyptic LA being rampaged by zombie like cannibals humans that have some kind of genetic infection local man renchard is forced to live a daily struggle as he trys to locate radio signals and find a cure.

title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
description: In the late 1880's, a widowed mother of three struggles to keep her family intact and to put food on the table. title: Brazil: An Inconvenient History
description: At first glance Brazil appears to be an alluring playground of exciting carnivals, sultry samba, divine football and a vibrantly diverse people. But behind this dazzling facade lies a disturbing story of history's largest-ever slave population. Astonishingly Brazil, a Portuguese colony, received ten-times more African slaves than the numbers transported to North America. This programme looks at those estimated 4 million people with whose blood, sweat and tears Brazil was built. Without them none of Brazil's present-day success and appeal would exist. Using contemporary testimonies, this film takes a hard look at Brazil's dark history through the eyes of those slaves. They lived in squalid conditions on remote plantations or in teeming cities harboring fatal diseases. Most Africans survived only seven years in this 'New World'. Some, however, did survive to create a new culture a fusion of African and European. This new ethnicity permeates and explains the modern Brazilian way of life. This outstanding film, winner of the Houston Film Festival Gold Award, is directed by Phil Grabsky. His film throws light on Brazil's inconvenient history.

title: An Oudist in Rumeli
description:
The documentary is about an oudist named Rasim Salih from Mitrovica, who has played a major role in the cultural development of the Turkish Communities living in Kosovo. The main character has started his music career during the beginning of the 1930s, although he had not previously taken any academic or professional education. His interest in music had started when he was 10, while watching his barber master play mandolin. During that time period, he had been working as a foreman in that barber shop, and later on had continued to develop his skills with the old music books he had found from people around. With the help of those books, he has later on developed his great music skills displayed on many Classical Turkish Music instruments. In 1951, a new era of cultural development begins when the Turkish Communities of Kosovo gain their cultural and educational rights. Throughout this phase, Rasim Salih has educated many young people about the Turkish Music in different Cultural Organizations of many towns in Kosovo. He has established and created the Orchestra of Turkish Arts Music, within the State Radio of Prishtina. Therefore, he has helped promote and emphasize the uniqueness of the Turkish Culture by bringing together musicians of Turkish and other communities that live in Kosovo. His works have introduced and promoted the values of the Kosovar Arts and Culture to many countries throughout the world.

 This documentary is made up of three main parts. In order to bring the sparkle to the documentary, on its first part the actors have artistically interpreted his childhood and youth. The second part articulates scenes from the archives. Whereas the third part encompasses the chronicles as described by Rasim Salih's professors, musicians, and friends.

title: Sex in an Epidemic
description: SEX IN AN EPIDEMIC is a pioneering documentary that explores the personal, political and structural challenges that have continually hampered the best efforts of HIV educators and community groups to curb HIV infection rates in the United States. It is a compelling history of the devastating early days of the epidemic in NYC, when men with "GRID" were a stigmatized population that died swiftly of a terrifying new disease. Few concepts have had as great an impact on sexuality over the past 28 years as that of "safer sex." Yet, as a concept, it is important to remember two things: first, safer sex had to be invented amidst an alarming lack of information that existed before the discovery of HIV in 1984; and second, safer sex as a concept had to be sold by the persistent and creative persuasion of community based groups all across the country.

title: An Elegy to Forgetting
description: The film documents a filmmaker's experience with his father's death due to Alzheimer's disease. Taken from a personal perspective, the filmmaker gives a first-hand look at how his family dealt with his father's worsening Alzheimer's disease and eventual death, leading him to realizations about memory, familial relationships, and his own mortality. The film delves into the importance of memories in the human experience - how the ability to remember makes us feel alive, how its power can hold us, and how memory gives us what we need to feel and be human.

title: Fadado ao Meu Vampiro Proibido
description: Durante toda a sua vida, Heather trabalhou como escrava para uma família de vampiros, até formar um vínculo inimaginável com Theo, um rei vampiro. Agora ela deve encontrar respostas para todos os mistérios: o que aconteceu com suas memórias perdidas de infância? Como aconteceu o vínculo? Theo é a morte dela ou o amor de sua vida?

title: Do Luto ao Luxo
description: A prodígio Xiao Hua vivia com a mãe, rejeitada pelo marido por sua aparência. Após a morte dela, Xiao Hua morre no casamento do pai com a amante. Renascida um ano antes, usa sua inteligência para salvar a mãe, mudar o visual, expor o canalha e se tornar a mulher mais rica.

title: Do Relâmpago ao Destino
description: Para tornar seu noivo bem-sucedido, ela o apoiava secretamente, mas não esperava que ele fizesse algo vergonhoso no dia do casamento! Quando foi maltratada pelo noivo canalha, um entregador que passava se levantou e disse que era seu namorado, então os dois se casaram rapidamente. Mas parece que ambos têm identidades ocultas desconhecidas pelo público...

title: Lima Barreto - Ao Terceiro Dia
description: On the last days of his life, while succumbing to alcoholism in a hospital, famed writer Lima Barreto chronicles his trajectory story as a black, poor writer living in Brazilian society between monarchy's dying days and early years of republic with its countless social problems, which formed the basis of his many novels.

title: Morrer a Rir - Roast ao Cancro
description: Tiago was diagnosed with cancer. As a cancer patient, he self-proposed his cancer to a Comedy Roast in order to raise funds to donate to IPO Lisboa.

title: Sacrificada ao Abismo, Coroada pelo Dragão
description: A sereia de cauda dourada puro-sangue Eve é traída por sua meia-irmã Vivian, seu noivo Arthur e seu próprio pai, sendo lançada no abismo. Renascida, ela rompe o noivado e mergulha nas profundezas como sacrifício, apenas para despertar Leviathan, o governante envenenado do abismo, com seu sangue divino. Determinada a descobrir a verdade sobre o assassinato de sua mãe, Eve se une ao possessivo deus dragão em busca de vingança. Porém, quando um exército de 100.000 soldados invade e a Rainha do Mar os separa, Eve precisa sacrificar seu coração para salvá-lo e sobreviver às Provações do Dragão Ancestral. Será que a rejeitada falsa cauda dourada da família conseguirá ascender à divindade e recuperar sua coroa?

title: A Infidelidade ao Alcance de Todos
description: Erotic comedy in two segments: in the first, a candidate running for mayor of a small town pays a visit to the most coveted woman in town,just to show off his manhood. In the other, three couples have fun in a different sort of New Year's eve party, but not according to their plans.

title: Ao Redor do Brasil
description: Images of Marshall Rondon's expeditions through the Amazon: the rivers, Indians, towns such as Tabatinga, Iquitos and Rio Branco, taken by Major Luiz Thomaz Reis, considered his main cinematographer.

title: Lendas Recomeçam ao Acordar
description: Ao despertar após milênios, o Senhor Supremo encontra sua noiva Emma Thompson e a família Thompson conspirando com aliados estrangeiros para cometer deicídio. Em um banquete perigoso, ele revela poderes divinos, destrói a conspiração para drenar a essência das Três Grandes Famílias, aniquila a linhagem Sunlight e detecta tremores cósmicos de Marte anunciando uma guerra divina.

title: Viagem ao Sol
description: Just after the Second World War, 5,000 young children were sent from Austria to stay with host families in Portugal, where they could recover from the violence of war. They were often welcomed in by well-to-do families with domestic staff living in sunny villas, and for most of the children this was a holiday in paradise. The contrast with their living conditions at home, and the huge difference between the lives of rich and poor in Portugal in this period, made a deep impression on the young Austrians.

title: O Deus Preso ao Destino
description: Fernando, um deus de mais de dois mil anos, foi enganado pela matriarca da família Soares a assinar um contrato, obrigando-o a protegê-la três vezes. Na terceira, ele salva Rafaela de um perigo mortal e acredita ter conquistado sua liberdade. Porém, o inesperado acontece: o pingente sagrado se parte, e cada metade entra em seus corpos. A partir daí, Fernando descobre que não pode mais se afastar de Rafaela a mais de três metros.

title: Algemada ao Chefe da Máfia
description: Sophie passa uma noite com Noah, chefe da máfia, e acaba engravidando. No momento do parto, sua irmã Grace a trai, fazendo-a assumir a culpa por um acidente. Presa, Sophie tem sua identidade roubada por Grace, que toma seu lugar e, ao lado da filha Alice, procura Noah para se tornar sua amante em sua luxuosa casa..

title: Ao Haru Ride S2
description: Revolves around Futaba, a girl who was in love with a boy named Ko Tanaka in middle school. However, it did not work because he transferred but in high school, her world is turned around once again when she meets him again.

title: Amores ao Cair da Tarde
description: Edna Pinto descobriu que o marido, Samuel Ricardo, a traía com a antiga paixão Kelly Lima, e que ele havia comprado um túmulo duplo para os dois. Revoltada, ela pediu divórcio. Após a separação, durante uma viagem para desopilar, conheceu por acaso o magnata Fernando Silveira, do Grupo QuroVasto, que se apaixonou por ela à primeira vista. Ele se fez passar por um candidato a encontro, cuidou dela com minúcia e a cortejou. Os dois se apaixonaram, mas enfrentaram a oposição dos filhos de ambos. Com sua força de caráter, Edna conquistou a aceitação da família de Fernando, e o carinho dele tocou o coração dos filhos dela. Superando obstáculos, eles finalmente se uniram — provando que os 50 anos também são a idade certa para buscar a felicidade.

title: Destinada ao Meu Vizinho Chefe
description: Após uma noite com Élio, Sheila dá à luz gêmeos. Catarina, sua malvada meia-irmã, rouba um dos bebês, finge ser sua mãe e se torna noiva de Élio. Seis anos depois, Sheila retorna como a famosa perfumista Sílvia, expõe as mentiras de Catarina, se reúne com seu filho roubado e se apaixona por Élio.

title: Assista ao Meu Casamento, e Chore!
description: Maria, filha mais velha do Grupo Ômega, cresceu tendo tudo roubado pela madrasta e pela meia-irmã. Por trás da frieza, esconde um coração frágil. Carlos, um segurança disfarçado, a machuca ao confundir Liliana com a garota da infância. Ao partir, ela reencontra Luís, que desperta de um coma, e recupera a felicidade. Quando a verdade vem à tona, Carlos tenta reconquistar Maria, enquanto Luís segue ao lado dela. O destino dos três se entrelaça em uma reviravolta sufocante.

title: Vendida ao Lobo Tirano
description: Isabela, uma Ômega desprezada, é vendida pela própria família gananciosa como moeda de troca para Ricardo, o temido "Lobo Tirano" e Alfa mais poderoso da alcateia, tornando-se sua companheira por contrato. Entre uma noite de casamento gelada, a traição da família e a rejeição da alcateia, ela vê sua vida mergulhar no desespero. Mas, durante um ataque mortal, Isabela desperta a linhagem selada da lendária Loba da Lua — um poder capaz de mudar seu destino para sempre.

title: Swordsman
description: Swordsman is a 2013 Chinese Martial television series adapted from Louis Cha's novel The Smiling, Proud Wanderer. The series is written and produced by Yu Zheng, starring Wallace Huo, Joe Chen, Yuan Shanshan, Chen Xiao, Yang Rong, Howie Huang, Wu Junyu, Deng Sha, and Bryan Leung. Shooting started on 24 March 2015 in Xiandu, Jinyun County, Lishui, Zhejiang.[1] It was first aired in China on Hunan Television from 6 February to 4 March 2013. The plot deviates significantly from the novel, with Dongfang Bubai depicted as a woman (instead of a castrated man) and having a romantic affair with Linghu Chong.

title: [Dublado]A Falsa Herdeira Sobe ao Trono
description:
No meu 99º renascimento, parei de lutar com a herdeira verdadeira, Lily Hart. Aceitei todas as falsas acusações que ela jogava em mim e deixei que minhas relações com meus dois amigos de infância se despedaçassem. Eu dizia a mim mesma que estava tudo bem. Pelo menos Wayne Fall ainda estava do meu lado. Isso durou até a festa de aniversário da Lily, quando o vestido dela de repente escorregou e quase a deixou exposta na frente de todos. Wayne a puxou para os braços dele e, pela primeira vez, virou a raiva dele contra mim. "Você ao menos lembra quem você é? Você não tem o sangue dos Hart. O que te faz pensar que pode competir com a Lily?" O que ele não sabia era que, toda vez que eu tentava expor a Lily, todos que eu amava morriam de formas horríveis. Na primeira vida, meu amigo de infância, Adrian Cole, foi esmagado sob um caminhão de carga, o crânio dele se estilhaçou. Na segunda, meu primo, Ryan Hayes, caiu de um arranha-céu e foi despedaçado no impacto. Na terceira, meu noivo, Wayne, ficou preso num incêndio e queimou vivo... 
Adrian e Ryan me jogaram no lago artificial da propriedade. Eu não sabia nadar. A água inundou meus pulmões até que lágrimas escorreram pelo meu rosto, mas não importava o quão desesperadamente eu implorasse por ajuda, nenhum deles reagiu. Quando minha consciência finalmente se apagou, alguém me arrastou para fora da água. Então ouvi eles falando. "Parece que ela finalmente aprendeu a lição. Pelo menos você não vai ter que continuar hipnotizando-a, Wayne. Eu estava começando a me preocupar que tanto comprimido fritasse o cérebro dela." "Com certeza vai haver algum dano cognitivo... Mas não tínhamos escolha. Lily é a filha verdadeira dos Hart. Se ela se recusasse a ceder, acabaria sendo expulsa da família mais cedo ou mais tarde." Então, os incontáveis "renascimentos" que eu vivi não passaram de uma ilusão. Eu simplesmente fui hipnotizada. Mas eu nunca precisei me agarrar a um lugar na família Hart. Eu também tinha uma família minha.

title: Hard Knock TV
description:
Launching HARD KNOCK TV in 2005, Nick Huff Barili, a veteran in the entertainment industry, recognized the need for credible in-depth coverage of Hip Hop culture and the emergence of new media. In 2006 Hard Knock TV became the FIRST Hip Hop show to create original content for Youtube. Hard Knock TV's Youtube channel has over 100 million views and 170 thousand subscribers, featuring some of the most viewed video interviews for some of today's stars such as Pharrell, Outkast, Wu-Tang, Common, Public Enemy, Kendrick Lamar, J Cole, ASAP Rocky, Logic, Jessie Reyez, Childish Gambino, Saweetie and Cordae.

In 2019 Nick launched Hard Knock TV Latino to showcase in-depth conversations (in Spanish and English) with Latino talent including J Balvin, Nicky Jam, Residente, Nicki Nicole, C Tangana, Bizarrap, Sech, Snow Tha Product, Cypress Hill, Farina and many more.

Being at the forefront of the video new media wave, Hard Knock TV has developed into a premier multi-platform video production and entertainment company, focusing on music, culture, sports and lifestyle. With thousands of hours of original programming being produced, aggregated, and distributed worldwide, Hard Knock TV has established itself as the go-to destination for original in-depth entertainment content. Delving into both the mainstream and underground world, Hard Knock TV digs beneath the surface for thought provoking content. Hard Knock's discerning and independent editorial voice, has earned a reputation in the entertainment industry as being the "Curators of Fresh".

Hard Knock TV lives up to the motto "Curators of Fresh" because of their unparalleled track record for being the first to discover emerging trends and talent on the rise to super-stardom. Nick has had the opportunity to interview and expose new artists to a large audience, often before they become household names providing audiences with their first in-depth good look at some of today's brightest talent.

title: STREETBEEFS | AP vs PSYCHO LUDA
description:
Streetbeefs operates 100% legally, with every participant 18 or older stepping in by choice. Founded by Scarface, Streetbeefs was featured in The New York Times documentary “Guns to Gloves” and highlighted in ESPN The Magazine (February 2019), putting a spotlight on a different way to handle conflict.

After witnessing too many people in the area seriously hurt — or worse — over pointless disputes, a solution was created: bring it to Satan’s Backyard and put the gloves on. No guns. No knives. No jumping. Just you, your opponent, the referee, and a crowd watching it unfold.

Hundreds of disputes have been settled this way, with the goal of settling thousands more — turning chaos into controlled combat. Some fights are strictly sport, some are real beef, but every match is real and raw. Streetbeefs isn’t just fights — it’s a brotherhood, a place where aggression gets redirected, bonds are built, and problems get handled without bodies dropping or lives being ruined.

It was a misunderstanding created by Waree's sister, Weeranat, who was fell in love with Pichet and became a paranoid woman until one day, Waree died and Sirin disappeared without a trace. Nabi, who has sees Pichet as a benefactor, starts working at his club in order to find traces of her sister. Meanwhile, Waree's death made Kawin, who was studying abroad ever since he finished high school, to go back to Thailand immediately and find out whether his mother's death was an accident or if she was killed. Before was going to study abroad, Kawin has confessed his love to Nabi and asked her to be his girlfriend, but she rejected him. Kawin didn't know Nabi also had feelings for him. They meet again when Pichet asks Nabi to be Kawin's assistant. They still have feelings for each other, but Kawin mistakenly thinks Nabi wants to become his stepmother. Will the anger, resentment and misunderstandings between them be resolved?

Innocent pining becomes silent obsession, however, when Dilip decides to install a surveillance camera directly over Rekha's bed. title: Bestmates at Jezzian
description:
Para sa maraming empleyado, it's payday dahil unang ‘a-kinse’ ng taon! Maraming ‘pumaldo’ sa unang sweldo this 2026! Kaya payo ni Teddy Corpuz, maging maingat sa mga online transactions dahil baka mabiktima ng scammers. Kaya naman si Jackie Gonzaga, ‘na-trigger’ at humugot!

Samantala, siksik sa kulitan ang ‘Laro-Laro Pick’ game arena kasama ang mga madlang players na taga-Valenzuela. Lahat ng naka-hoodie, pumila para sa 'Not Cute Anymore' trend! Nakilala rin natin si Lao, na inspiring ang positivity sa kabila ng pagkakaroon ng tumor. Present din si Ferdie na para bang karakter sa "FPJ's Batang Quiapo" ang pormahan. Si Ambel naman, tricycle driver, sobrang komportable sa game arena na para bang kasama lang niyang tumambay ang mga ka-toda.

May mga espesyal pang bisita! Nakilaro rin sina Gladys Reyes at Neil Ryan Sese, na nag-enjoy pa rin kahit na-eliminate agad sa unang round. Pabiro pang tinalakan ni Gladys ang nag-o-operate ng ilaw sa ‘Illuminate or Eliminate’ game.

Siksik sa kulitan ang ‘Laro-Laro Pick’ game arena kasama ang mga madlang players na taga-Valenzuela. The luckiest of them all ay si Jose, isang janitor at mapagmahal na ama sa dalawang anak at asawa sa misis na 'caregiver.'

Para sa Li-Pot offer, dinoble nina Kim Chiu at Jackie Gonzaga ang buwanang sweldo ni Jose, kaya may P30,000 na pwede niyang tanggapin. Matagal-tagal din pinag-isipan ni Jose ang pipiliin. No'ng una'y nag-Li-Pot siya, pero nakumbinsi ni Vice Ganda na mag-Pot sa dulo kung saan P200k ang katumbas ng tanong na, "Ano ang ibig sabihin ng 'Q' sa QR code?"

"Quality," sabi ni Jose. Pero hindi ito ang tamang sagot. Para pasayahin si Jose, nangako si Vice na bibigyan niya ito ng pang-grocery para may maiuwi pa rin sa kanyang mag-iina.

One plus one equals intense bosesan sa tanghalan. Sa Day 4 ng "TNT Duets 2" weeklong Grand Finals, dinala ng tatlong duos sa isang musical adventure na may iba't ibang 'feels' sina hurado Kyla, Erik Santos, Yeng Constantino, Jonathan Manalo at Punong Hurado Louie Ocampo.

Unang sumabak sa entablado ang 'Dua Bisdak' Juliana Tagalog at Shane Castillo. Fierce ang kanilang tunugan sa pagkanta ng "Marupok" ni KZ Tandingan. Speaking of "marupok," tinanong ni Vice Ganda si Kim Chiu kung marupok ba ito. At ang sagot ng

Chinita Princess, "I'm just a loving person." Oh, pak! Eh, kung si Darren Espanto ang tatanungin, ayun ‘napaamin.’ Saan nga ba marupok si bestie Darren?

Samantala, komento ni hurado Yeng, "Mayroong parts sa umpisa na medyo nadumihan talaga ako." May 'kakampi' si Yeng dahil sumang-ayon sa kan'yang opinyon si hurado Kyla, na pinayuhan sina Shane at Juliana tungkol sa "slurring." Kumontra si Erik, na sinabing hindi siya "nadumihan" but he found the performance "dragging." Ang markang nakuha ng Dua Bisdak ay 91.2%.

Sa digmaan sa tanghalan, magkasangga rin sina Thor Valiente at Pia Carandang a.k.a. 'TNT Bestmates' na pinakilig ang lahat sa kanilang "'Til I Met You" performance na nakatanggap ng standing ovation mula sa mga hurados. Inilarawan ni Maestro Louie ang pag-awit bilang "creative" at "hard to beat." Pakiramdam naman ni hurado Jonathan ay para siyang nanonood ng pelikula sa tila movie soundtrack na performance. Parang na-senti nga raw si hurado Erik kahit wala namang pinagdadaanan. Nakakuha ng score na 96.8% ang TNT Bestmates.

Hard to beat man ang naunang duo, hindi nagpatinag sina Jezza Quiogue at Ian Manibale a.k.a. 'Jezzian.' Ang hugot hit ni Moira Dela Torre na "Ikaw At Sila," ginawa nilang mas mapanakit pa.

Mahaba-haba ang naging diskusyon ng mga hurado. "Parehong heightened ang emotions." Ipinaliwanag ni hurado Jonathan na hindi sila nakapag-standing ovation kina Ian at Jezza dahil sa sobrang sakit ng awitin. Mas tumaas pa ang tensyon at excitement nang sabihin ni Maestro Louie, "Para akong nanganak ng kambal. Hindi ko pwedeng iwanan 'yung isa. Magkaiba pero pareho 'yung pagmamahal sa dalawa."

Sa huli, nag-tie ang 'TNT Bestmates' at 'Jezzian' sa score na 96.8%. Aabante ang dalawang duo sa Huling Tapatan sa Sabado.

All they need is an inside man, Edwin Sage, to help iron out a few of the details. Everyone is blissful in their ignorance until Edwin, a tinge insecure about his ability to deliver, consults his cousin, and head of the local anti-robbery task force, Max Heavy. Oppressed by the disdain of his social circle, the sheer listlessness of his existence, and enough script "how-to" literary principles to fill the vault he'll probably die in, Edwin is not only a failure, he's an accessory. description: District Attorney Graham starts a crusade against the city's gambling houses. Hunter, polished, dashing and handsome, is seemingly devoted to Aline, and manages to marry her secretly. Later, in a raid on Flagg's place, Hunter shoots Graham and runs to Aline with the plea that unless she gives him money he will divulge the whole affair, saying that the marriage was a fake to aid some political enemies of her father. He leaves with her necklace, but she writes to him at Flagg's office begging him not to desert her. How she is finally rescued and her fair name saved makes a charming ending to this drama.

title: Switched at Jealousy
description: In Obreford, billionaire Ysabel Harper and Darlene Anderson give birth on the same day, but Darlene secretly swaps their babies. Seventeen years later, the true heiress, Minnie, endures abuse and hardship while living with Darlene, whereas the false heiress, Camellia, enjoys a carefree life and often bullies Minnie. Fortunately, Ysabel eventually discovers the truth and reclaims her biological daughter, Minnie. However, Darlene’s ambitions are far from over; she conspires with the Lawson family to undermine the Harper family’s status. When her plan ultimately fails, she murders her own daughter, Camellia, in a fit of rage. As the investigation deepens, Ysabel uncovers that the true mastermind behind the schemes is her sister-in-law, Kaylee Allen. Kaylee has always believed that Ysabel’s wealth comes from her late brother, Blake Allen’s, inheritance, but in reality, Ysabel’s success is due to her own hard work and intelligence. Blake is revealed to be a mere “kept man” living off Ysabel, and after the truth comes to light, Kaylee is sent to prison. In the end, Ysabel clears Minnie’s name, and the mother and daughter reunite, finding happiness together.

title: Larzac
description: Seated in his office in Paris, one day of October 1971, Michel Debré, minister of the Defence declares: We choose the Larzac as it is a deprived land. With no prior dialogue, his decision to extend the military camp of the Larzac is made. The first reaction of the peasants is radical: "If they want our farms and lands, we'll leave them dead and we won't be the only dead around" He sets an unanimous wave of protestations and resistances; the beginning of an amazing struggle, that will last for ten years until the elections for Presidency of May 1981

title: Viper in the Fist

title: Retour au Palais
description: The first time I ever stepped into the Courthouse in Paris, I was twenty. It was already a thousand-years old monument. 6999 doors, 3150 windows, 24 kilometers of corridors, according to the legend. I have been working there for over ten years. I was a court reporter. On the nights when I had to stay late awaiting for a verdict, I would step away from the lights and sink into darker and darker corridors. I would hear rumblings coming from deep down. I had the feeling that the House was alive and it appeared to be moving. It's impending removal hastens my return. I come back to the courthouse with no trial to follow. From its maze of passages and my encounters, from its lurking stories, the portrait of an abstraction emerges piece by piece : justice.

title: Au nom de la grèce
description: In 2015, in the midst of the crisis, Greece brought to power the Tsipras government from the Syriza party with a resolutely alternative program. They strove to put an end to the austerity that had brought their country to its knees since 2009. However they had to face an inflexible Troika - the IMF, the ECB and the European Commission - and a sightless Europe. The latter was doing nothing better than setting ultimatums. Europe was ready to sacrifice one of its own member, Greece, the cradle of democracy and of its cultural roots. For the first time, members of this government, including Yanis Varoufakis, former Greek Finance Minister testify to evoke the Greek resistance. They reveal the backstage of these abysmal negotiations and their experience of power. They talk about their "war", their hopes, their failures and what really happened beyond the media storytelling. The Greek response to the crisis questions the idea of the European solidarity. This fight reveals the dysfunctions of a broken Union and questions a certain idea of Europe. Mixed with the political interview the film capture the reflection of Greek artists on their view on concrete repercussions of the crisis and the political and economic sense to give back to the people. The Greek crisis questions us as Europeans, our aspirations, fears, our political and economic choices. It acts as mirror of ourselves. A parable of our time.

title: Miles from Anywhere
description:
Christina, bientôt 30 ans, vit dans la région de Charleroi en Belgique, avec Marco, son petit ami. A la mort de sa grand-mère, elle hérite dune maison en Corse. Dans son entourage, personne ne semble savoir pourquoi la vieille dame possédait cette maison. Sa famille presse Christina de vendre son bien. Mais elle sy refuse. Elle veut comprendre pourquoi sa grand-mère lui a laissé cet étrange legs. Elle voit aussi en cet héritage une occasion unique de remettre en question sa vie monotone. Sur un coup de tête, elle part seule à la découverte de sa maison. Ce voyage va bousculer son existence. Et celle de ses proches.



Almost thirty, she lives near Charleroi with her boyfriend Marco. When her grandmother dies, Christina inherits a house in Corsica. Nobody in her family seems to know how and when the old woman acquired the house. Everyone in her family, and Marco too, try to convince her to sell the house, but she refuses. She wants to understand why her grandmother wanted her to inherit it. This inheritance gives her the opportunity to put into question the monotony of her life. She decides to leave on her own to discover the house. This trip is going to turn her life, and that of those close to her, upside down

title: Au nom du maintien de l'ordre
description: A new global phenomenon: over-equipped police facing furious, defenseless crowds brandishing their cell phones to record everything. The war of images on social media further polarizes police and demonstrators.

title: Une saison au paradis
description: From political exile in France, Breyten Breytenbach came to South Africa in 1972 on a special visit to introduce his wife, Yolande, to his family and to the country of his heart. On this trip he was informed by the South African state that he would no longer be accepted into the country after his return to France. In 1975, however, Breytenbach made an illegal entrance to South Africa to recruit members to an anti-apartheid movement being set up outside the country. The security police became aware of his presence in the country and he was caught, interrogated and imprisoned in isolation in Pretoria. This poignantly told (auto)biography reveals the pain and the beauty of the life of a South African visionary, as he returns to his beloved country to travel his landscape of memory.

title: Au delà de la haine
description: In 2002, three French neofascist skinheads went to a public park in Rheims looking for an 'Arab' to attack when they came across Francois Chenu, a young gay man.

title: De la Cuisine au Trône
description: La petite-fille d'une légende culinaire disparue revient s'affronter pour le titre de Chef Suprême, et fait succomber le PDG du restaurant.

title: INVITÉES AU MARIAGE DE MON AMOUR
description: Mathis Laurent et ses deux amies d’enfance fondent une entreprise, mais après cinq ans, elles succombent au charme d’un arriviste. Lorsqu’il s’effondre, épuisé, Mathis comprend la vérité : elles choisissent de croire en cet arriviste. Désabusé, il vend ses parts et accepte un mariage arrangé.

title: Au cimetière de la pellicule
description: Diallo sets out with his camera in search of the birth of filmmaking in Guinea. Charming and determined, he traces his country's film heritage and history and reveals the importance of film archives.

title: His Deadly Affair

title: Invincible au village, faible ailleurs
description: Fabien entre dans le jeu pour sauver sa sœur, mais il se fait harceler et bloquer au village débutants par un antagoniste. Quand les démons attaquent, il active le « Système d'invincibilité du nouveau » et, niveau 1, tue un général démon et un seigneur démon à mains nues. Pour éviter que les cœurs de démon ne polluent le village, il accepte une mission d'escorte afin d'obtenir une « carte d'invincibilité ». Sans buff, il quitte le village, donne son équipement légendaire à des inconnus, et ses coéquipiers, croyant qu'il est un génie caché, éliminent tous les monstres sur son chemin jusqu'à la capitale. Là, l'antagoniste le provoque devant tous. Bloqué, Fabien est sur le point d'être touché quand le système lui accorde la « Carte d'essai de puissance divine ».

title: Awakening Mind Part 3 - Liberation
description:
If awakening is the end of seeking, then liberation is the end of the seeker.

Awakening Mind Part 3: Liberation explores what lies beyond the initial recognition of our true nature. Many on the spiritual path experience awakening as a profound moment when the veil lifts... when the search collapses and Being recognizes itself. Yet for many, something subtle remains. Old tendencies, unconscious patterns, and deeply rooted habits of identification... known in the Eastern traditions as vasanas and samskaras continue to move quietly beneath the surface.

Liberation is not the acquisition of a higher state, nor the refinement of a spiritual identity. It is the dissolution of the one who would attain, practice, or improve. This film points beyond awakening as an event and into the complete release of the seeker itself.

Introduction: Beyond the Glimpse (0:00)

The film opens by clarifying a crucial distinction: awakening and liberation are not the same. Awakening reveals what is true; liberation removes what is false. Liberation is not a new teaching, technique, or philosophy. It is a direct pointing to what remains when the path itself dissolves, when there is no longer anyone left to walk it.

This is not an ending and not a beginning, but a recognition of that which was never born and never dies.

The Ox Herding Pictures: A Map Without a Path (5:30)

The backbone of the film is the Zen Ox Herding Pictures, an ancient visual metaphor describing the unfolding of realization from seeking, to recognition, to embodiment, and finally to freedom within the world.

Rather than presenting liberation as an escape from life, the Ox Herding Pictures reveal it as a progressive undoing of false identity, culminating in a return to ordinary life without attachment or pretense.

Searching, Seeing, and Recognizing (7:30-24:54)

The early stages of the Ox Herding journey are explored through teachings from Advaita Vedanta and Zen:

Searching for the Ox reflects the existential longing that drives the spiritual impulse.

Seeing the Traces marks the first intuitions that something deeper is at play.

Seeing the Ox represents the direct glimpse of awakening itself.

Through voices such as Swami Sarvapriyananda, Rupert Spira, Nisargadatta Maharaj, Ramana Maharshi, and others, the film emphasizes self-inquiry as the central tool.

Meditation is reframed not as concentration or control, but as inquiry: a willingness to look directly at the sense of self until it dissolves.

description: Jiang Wencai (Hou Ren Choo) seems to have it all, a stable career and a happy family, until his eldest daughter Jiang Yijuan (Priscelia Chan) unexpectedly announces her engagement to an assistant designer, Zhang Shunfa (Pierre Png). Distrustful of Shunfa and yet unable to express his objections, Wencai offers to rent a room to him so that he can chaperone the couple as he plots to break them up. But soon, Wencai realizes that his future son-in-law is not his only problem. His eldest son Junji (Yaodong Zhang) is being led into risky investments by his capricious mother-in-law; his second daughter Yijun (Jeanette Aw) whom he was proud of returned from abroad without completing her degree; his neglected teenager son and daughter also get into trouble behind his back. In turn, it was Shunfa who helps him resolve his family problems. Unable to take the many setbacks, Wencai collapses and falls sick. Convinced of her own illness, the once aggressive and arrogant Kexin slips into a depression and attempted suicide. Her siblings Kexi (Andie Chen) and Keyi (Jeanette Aw), whom she was estrange from, begin to rally around her. With her family's encouragement and love, Kexin recovers and gains not just a new perspective in life. Weiye's mis-management is leading the company into trouble. title: Sana ay ikaw na nga
description: The story revolves around two lovers whose romance is against all odds. Carlos Miguel Altamonte, a handsome, rich guy, meets the poor but charming barrio lass, Cecilia Fulgencio. It was love at first sight for both of them. There's a hitch, however, Carlos Miguel is trapped in an arranged marriage with Olga Villavicer, a woman he doesn't really love. Yet, Carlos Miguel and Cecilia's love for each other proves strong enough to motivate the former to back out to the designed commitment and pursue his newfound bliss. Carlos Miguel fought for his love for Cecilia and succeeded in wooing her to tie the knot with him. On the other hand, Olga, unable to accept defeat, sets an evil plan into action. A scheme that will entirely change Cecilia's life and worse, lose her own identity.

description:
Sa tamang alaga, ang pangarap ay nagbubunga. At kapag hinog na, matitikman ang tamis, saya’t tawa. Dito sa "It’s Showtime," positive mindset ang itinatanim para good vibes ang aanihin.

Doblehin pa ang happiness dahil present ang bandang Lola Amour para lambingin ang ating mga puso’t pandinig with their latest single “Lambing.”

Bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang mga taga-Tangos, Navotas. JackPOT money ay ma-a-achieve na ba sa wakas? Siksik sa kulitan ang kuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda at player Olay. Dahil sa hanapbuhay ni nanay na pagtitinda ng mga underwear sa bangketa, kung anu-anong kuwentong nakakatawa ang naalala ni Vice Ganda.

Mula sa tindera ng underwear, sumunod na kinilala nina Meme si player Vina, na itlog naman ang ibinebenta. Hindi rin nakatakas sa mga punchline ni Meme ang pag-absent ni Anne Curtis.

Si Alvin, isang pintor ng barko, ang nagkaroon ng pagkakataon na masungkit ang P300,000 na panalo. Hindi man siya sumugal sa POT question, sure win naman si Alvin sa P30,000 Li-Pot offer mula kina Jackie Gonzaga at Karylle.

Na-in love sina Marielle Montellano, Punong Hurado Louie Ocampo, at Klarisse De Guzman sa vibe ng BARMM Region contestants sa ‘Tawag Ng Tanghalan.’ Bitbit ang bandera ng Marawi City, ibinida ni Najib ang talento sa TNT entablado sa isang mapusong pag-awit ng "Huwag Ka Nang Umiyak.” Sa kanilang bayan, mga endangered species ang inaalagan ni Nerissa. Pero dito sa TNT, pangarap at tinig ang alaga niya sa performance.

title: SWERTE ay buhay na busay kasama ang mga taga-PASAY
description:
Kung may mga astronauts na nagbabalik from the moon back to planet Earth, binitbit naman ng Nation's Girl Group, BINI, ang pride ng Pilipinas across the globe as they debuted on the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival, na kasalukuyang ginaganap sa Indio, California. Kaya very proud ang mga Blooms at lahat ng Kapamilya, pati na ang buong "It's Showtime" family sa historic performance ng BINI.

Samantala, blooming din ang saya at papremyo sa 'Laro Laro Pick' hosted by Jhong Hilario, Kim Chiu at Vhong Navarro, na nagpuksaan muna ng OOTDs bago 'nakipagkembutan' sa Madlang People. Energy ay buhay na buhay sa pagpasok ng mga players na nagmula pa sa Malibay, Pasay. Mga kababayan pala ito ni Kuys Vhong, na napa-reminisce sa kan'yang Pasay days. Sa jackpot round, maging excellent kaya ang diskarte ni player Aileen? Ano ang kan’yang pipiliin? P150,000 Pot question o P20,000 sa Li-Pot?

Katulad ng BINI, maipagmamalaki rin globally ang mga Region 10 pambato na sumalang sa ika-sampung Regional Finals ng 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan.' Sino ang pinakapasado sa mga gwapong hurado na sina Erik Santos, Ogie Alcasid, at Nyoy Volante?

Ma-TEN-di ang determinasyon ni Andrei Delig na tanghaling kampeon sa pamamagitan ng kan'yang tinig. Ika'y mapapapikit, at sa puso mo mapapakapit, habang pinakikinggan ang awitin niyang alay, titled "Kabilang Buhay."

Mapanakit din ang pag-awit ng ikalawang contender, Jes Torres, singing the Sam Smith hit "Too Good at Goodbyes." Pati ang ikatlong kalahok na si Jay Elago, umawit nang tagos sa puso, gamit ang piyesang "Mundo."

Break muna sa pagpapatawa si Jonmer Abel. Serious mode muna siya sa pagkanta ng "Tatsulok," hoping na sa trono ng kampeon siya'y mailuklok. Pinaghalong kilig at pighati ang ipininta ni Jane Baranggan as she belted out "Ako'y Sa'yo, Ika'y Akin Lamang." Kahit muntik nang humudyat ng gong ang mga hurado, lumaban siya hanggang dulo.

Ang itinanghal na best ay si Jes, na nakakuha ng score na 93.3%. Nasa ikalawang puwesto naman si Andrei, at ikatlo si Jay. Samantala, pag-apat si Jonmar at ikalima si Jane.

title: Swerte ay hindi 'far' kasama ang mga taga-Fairview
description:
Fresh from "PBB Collab 2.0," nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado si 'TNT The School Showdown' champ Carmelle Collado , at may bitbit pang cutie ex-housemate na naka-close niya sa Bahay Ni Kuya, si Anton Vinzon.

Tanggapin n'yo ang pa-deliver na 'ayuda' nina Carmelle at Anton—isang nakaka-in love na duet ng "Araw Gabi." The CarTon ship is sailing na ba? Shookt naman sina Carmelle at Anton nang marinig ang boses ni Kuya! Nami-miss na nga ba sila ni Big Brother?

Hindi far, kundi very near ang swerte para sa mga residente ng Fairview, Quezon City na super game makipagkulitan sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Hindi pa man nagsisimula ang laro, nakuha na agad ni Serly ang paghanga ng madlang people dahil sa work niyang very noble. Isa siyang guro ng mga batang may special needs. Sending salary increase dust sa lahat ng mga teachers, at manggagawang Pilipino!

Sa You Gotta Lyric, "Hawak Kamay" ang bida sa sing-along. Napaaga ang celebration ni Jugs Jugueta, pero ang ending, mali pala!

Forda paypay si Weng para ma-survive ang PILImination with her partner PILIminator Ryan Bang. Palaban si Weng, ang solo parent, na may pinagdaanan sa kan'yang kalusugan. Nakuntento na si Weng sa P25k ang Li-Pot offer. Good decision! Dahil hindi nya nasagot ang POT question.

Nagpapatuloy ang tagisan ng galing ng mga taga-Region 5 a Ika-10 Taon ng 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan.'

Tunog matinee idol ang pangalan ni first contender, John Loyd, na idinuyan ang madlang people sa awiting "Ulap." Na-enjoy naman nina Jed Madela, Marielle Montellano, at Ogie Alcasid ang performance. Sabi nila, he came prepared.

Ang ikalawang contender ay si Ricmar, na mahusay sa sales talk. Bumenta rin ang kanyang rendisyon ng awiting "Diamante." Sabi ng mga hurado, na-impress sila sa high notes pero hindi masyadong tumagos, bagama't malaki ang potensyal ng kalahok.

Itinanghal na panalo si John Loyd sa score na 93.7% laban sa 90.7% ni Ricmar.

title: MINE n'yo na Brent at Ralph pasado ba bilang ESCORTS
description:
P-Pop rise! Nagdala ng fresh energy sa studio ang 12-member P-Pop group AZTER sa isang hataw at nakaka-LSS na performance ng kanilang kantang “Parang May Mali.”

Positive ang heart, pero dapat mabilis din ang isip dahil sa Miss Q and A, hindi sapat ang confidence at ganda kundi kailangan din ng wit. Nagpakitang-gilas sa talakan sina Tinderella Marie, C-Jay Ubias Tablit, at Serenity Winter.

Para bang na-manifest ni Tinderella ang sariling pagkalotlot dahil nagkatotoo ang sinabi niyang excited siyang “tumalot.” Siya nga ang unang naligwak matapos maunahan ng mga kalaban sa pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round.

Sina Serenity at C-Jay naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang, kung saan muling nasubok ang kanilang husay sa pagsagot sa playtime questions.

Umulan naman ng kilig at hiyawan sa studio sa pagpasok ng bagong duo na may hawak ng bowl of questions. Sina Brent Manalo at Ralph de Leon muna ang escorts for today. Para patunayan na deserve nila ang posisyon, daanin sa joke time ang audition.

Laging handa, ‘yan ang motto ng ating mga scout. Kaya sa pagsabak nila sa Laro Laro Pick, walang puwang ang doubt. Boy Scouts of the Philippines ang players for today's video. Ang swerte, sa kanila ba ay sasaludo?

Na-curious si Vice Ganda nang makita ang mga girl sa hanay ng players na bahagi ng Boy Scouts of the Philippines. Sa jackpot round, si Yel ang umabante para sa chance na maiuwi ang P200,000 POT money. Naibigay kaya ni Yel ang tamang sagot at naiuwi ang malaking POT money?

title: Kung si Darren ang manghaharana, mapapa-OO ka ba?
description:
You and me, magiging happy dahil sa performance ng YUMI, ang girl group mula sa isang teleserye na kinabibilangan nina Zephanie, Olive May, Naya, Gaea and Mitzi. Naki-join din sa kulitan si Bianca Umali. Pero bago ang hosting duties, kumasa muna siya sa “Meme” dance challenge.

Sa "Miss Q and A," bawat tanong may kasamang excitement at thrill. Stick to friendly competition lang sina Kim Sumaway, Freda, at Queen Sam Ri. Sisterly bond nila ay tumibay na backstage. Pero huwag malilito, hindi si Freda ang "kuya" sa kanilang tatlo!

Eh, kung si Darren Espanto ba naman ang manghaharana, mapapa-oo ka talaga!

Nabuhayan ang mga bisitang estudyante dahil ang mga naligwak, nabigyan ng pagkakataon na pumakak sa jackpot. Nabunot ang pangalan ni Dayan, na matapang na sinugalan ang POT question.

title: Be Here
description: Chris Marks travels all over the world to discover the adventures that our planet has to offer. Chris shares his experiences to encourage people to be visit these places and when they do, they should always Be Here.

title: To Be You
description: After Howard falls in love with a beautiful Ghanaian woman he meets online, he is unexpectedly informed by a mysterious outsider that she may not be who he thinks she is.

title: Be Somebody
description: Pop superstar Jordan Jaye has a big dream - he just wants to live like a regular teenager. When he's chased down by some excited female fans, he finds a perfect hideout and a reluctant new friend from a small town, high-school art student, Emily Lowe. Despite being from different worlds, they soon discover they have way more in common than they ever imagined. Over the course of several days, the two embark on an unexpected journey of friendship, first love and self-discovery -- proving that maybe opposites really do attract.

title: Jenny Be Good
description: When a young woman's great romance is interrupted by the influence of her lover's parents, she turns to her art as a violinist to console herself. As she is about to achieve her highest triumph, she is suddenly confronted by the return of the man she loves and she must make a choice.

title: Be My Heart Be Your Eye
description: Wealthy heir Tim marries his equally matched fiancée for family interests, coldly abandoning Laura, his assistant, with whom he had secretly dated for three years. Suffering from critical heart failure, Laura tries to confess but is rejected. Heartbroken and desperate, she intends to donate her corneas to her childhood blind playmate named Tim before dying... unaware this very Tim is now her ex-lover himself, adopted and restored to sight.

title: Must Be... Love
description: Patricia falls in love with her childhood best friend Ivan, but he is in love with his cousin Angel. Will they ever be together?
